payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses inclusion-exclusion formula to compute Stirling numbers of the second kind S(n,k) directly via sum_{i=0}^k (-1)^i * C(k,i) * (k-i)^n / k!.
payload.rationale: Problem counts set partitions into non-empty boxes, a combinatorial counting task. The subtype dp_counting_combinatorics fits the category, though the solution uses a closed-form formula rather than DP.
